name: Smooth Gradient Estimation via Convolution
aliases: Leibniz Rule Gradient Estimation via Convolution
definition: A technique to enable differentiation of the rendering equation by smoothing the integrand via convolution with a kernel, allowing the differential operator to move inside the integral.
summary: Smooth Gradient Estimation via Convolution enables differentiating the rendering equation by smoothing the integrand with a kernel, allowing differentiation and integration to commute where naive methods fail.
